title: Monotonic deadline with clamped remaining and chunk checks
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag time comparisons at the exact boundary. The contract states expiry at or after the end instant, remaining() is clamped at zero, and durations come only from the injected monotonic clock, never time.time().
